messages.subject: MSstatsTMT output
parts:
Hello, hope it is the right place to ask about the output of the MSstatsTMT. Everything seems to be working good but in the final output table (see " test.pairwise" below) I'm seeing multiple entries containing the same protein, i.e.

P19367
P19367;P52789
P19367;P52789;P52790
P19367;P52789;Q2TB90;P52790
P19367;Q2TB90 

and every row has different channel intensities which are confusing if you want to quantify P19367. I understand that if we use shared peptides we can end up with protein groups but here  instead of one large protein group we have also a smaller group up to a single protein... And in the settings, only the unique peptide IDs were used for quantification...

messages.author: 0f36a4d38f68e366
messages.subject: Re: MSstatsTMT output
parts: Which data processing tools did you use? MSstatsTMT uses the protein IDs provided by the data processing tools. It is highly possible that the tool grouped the proteins like your example cases.
